background.text: Studies of the Fetus in the Womb are two coloured annotated sketches by Leonardo da Vinci made in around 1511. The studies correctly depict the human fetus in its proper position inside a dissected uterus. Leonardo depicted the uterus with one chamber, in contrast to theories that the uterus had multiple chambers which many believed divided fetuses into separate compartments in the case of twins. Leonardo also correctly drew the uterine artery and the vascular system of the cervix and vagina.
Gli Studi anatomici di feto nell'utero sono due schizzi a colori realizzati da Leonardo da Vinci intorno al 1511 e attualmente parte della Royal Collection.

Les études du fœtus dans l'utérus sont deux esquisses annotées et colorées du peintre florentin Léonard de Vinci, réalisées vers 1511. Ces études représentent correctement le fœtus humain dans sa position appropriée, dans un utérus disséqué.
